import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    values = [int(x) for line in lines for x in line.split()]
    n = len(values)
    print("count", n)
    if n == 0:
        return
    total = sum(values)
    mean = total / n
    mean_str = f"{mean:.2f}".replace("-0.00", "0.00")
    print("mean", mean_str)
    s = sorted(values)
    mid = n // 2
    if n % 2 == 0:
        median = (s[mid - 1] + s[mid]) / 2
    else:
        median = s[mid]
    print("median", median)
    counts = {}
    for v in values:
        counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    max_count = max(counts.values())
    modes = [k for k, v in counts.items() if v == max_count]
    mode = min(modes)
    print("mode", mode)
    print("range", max(values) - min(values))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
